spec.basis: Andrew, 19 Oct 2026: "It should be 1191657 it a coates machine we need all these cleaned up please". VMS13 on T0158 carried two numbers: the register's 1191657 (Andrew's) and a 16 Oct unit record typed 1191957 from the contract line. The 1191957 record is set aside, so T0158 holds its nine boards once each.

ops.text: VMS13 confirmed by Andrew 19 Oct 2026: 1191657, a Coates machine (the contract line's 1191957 is the branch's to correct).

delivery/T0158.note: Came in 16 Oct 2026 for Monday 19 Oct: VMS13 Senior 1191957 rego EN3803 (Andrew wrote 1191657; the contract line reads 1191957, one digit apart, to be checked on the plate); VMS14 Junior 1201864 rego TD98VJ; VMS15 Senior 1211348 rego ER9217; VMS16 Senior 1211376 rego ES3211; VMS17 Senior 1211364 rego ER9410. Contract 9961265 lines 32, 34, 35, 37, 39. Regos as Andrew read them off the boards, 16 Oct. VMS19 arrived 19 Oct 2026: Premiair Hire sub-hire, fleet 487T, rego TE02H0 (contract 9961265 line 25). VMS18 arrived 19 Oct 2026: Premiair Hire sub-hire, fleet 472T, rego TE58GZ (contract 9961265 line 24). VMS20 arrived and completed 19 Oct 2026: Premiair Hire sub-hire, fleet 475T, rego TE88HN (contract 9961265 line 26). VMS23 arrived 19 Oct 2026: Premiair Hire sub-hire, fleet 453T, rego TF54CQ (contract 9961265 line 30).

history.note: Andrew, 18 Oct: "They are here already onsite. They turned up friday". Dated by the regos he read off these five boards on site, Fri 16 Oct 12:09 AEST.
